              How a week works

              1. Friday

                Drafted here. You get an email at 16:00.

              2. Before Monday

                Preview, send yourself a test, then approve.

              3. Monday 07:00

                It goes out and the page goes live.

              Pricing

              Every rate and limit the free tools use.

              Prices only ever appear inside a private report. Each save is a new version, and a report keeps the version it was priced with.

              Website CheckGoogle Ads Check
              £–Hourly rateDay rate ÷ hours

              Your rate

              What an hour of work costs.

              A report adds the set-up once, then prices each job on its time, rounded to the nearest pound. If the day rate changes, update the rate card page too.

              Google Ads monthly

              The monthly option in Google Ads reports.

              The fee is the account's estimated hours a month times the hourly rate, rounded, and never under the minimum. Hours come from the campaigns that spent in the last 30 days and the 30-day spend. An empty minimum hides the monthly option.

              The fee

              Hours a month

              Customers see “Lewis will confirm this within one working day”.

              Time per fix

              Set-up plus minutes per item, from the account's own counts.

              Reports price each job on its AI-assisted time. Leave both AI boxes empty for a job that can't be done quickly with AI: it keeps the time by hand. Hand times were estimated on 16 Nov 2026 and AI times on 19 Nov 2026; tune both against real jobs.

              FixAn item isBy hand, set-upBy hand, per itemWith AI, set-upWith AI, per item

              Free-use limits

              How much the free checks can be used.

              Explorer access allows 2,880 Google Ads operations a day and a check uses about 25 to 60, so keep the daily ceiling under about 48 until Basic access is approved. Each Website Check uses two of Google's free PageSpeed calls (25,000 a day); a site checked again inside the reuse window costs nothing.

              Free checks

              Checks visitors finished, last eight weeks.

              Your own runs aren't counted. A Lead card is made when a visitor leaves their details after a check. Refused means the check never ran: crawlers, failed spam checks, too many tries from one connection, or the free-use limits.
